chunks: We have divided the Qur'an into parts that you may recite it to men slowly, with deliberation. That is why We sent it down by degrees.

key_terms.تَنزِيلًا: A sending down / descent (emphasizing the manner of revelation)
key_terms.فَرَقْنَاهُ: We divided it (referring to the Qur'an)
key_terms.لِتَقْرَأَهُ: So that you may recite it

ai.seo_question: How was the Qur'an revealed to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the wisdom behind the gradual revelation (tanzil) of the Qur'an, a concept central to Shia exegesis which views the pacing as a divine mercy to strengthen the Prophet's heart and facilitate the community's comprehension. It underscores the deliberate, piecemeal nature of the descent, contrasting with the idea of a single instantaneous disclosure, thereby affirming the Qur'an's role as a sustained guide for humanity.
